Al-Mansur moved the treasury and the diwans there from Kufa in 146 AH/763 CE . Its markets were then moved to al-Karkh in 773 CE, and the city spread over both banks of the Tigris  . entries.claim: Baghdad lies on both banks of the Tigris. The Encyclopaedia of Islam, whose account this page follows, says it was founded in the eighth century, remained the centre of the Abbasid caliphate until that caliphate fell, and was for centuries the cultural metropolis of the Muslim world.
